preconditions.description: The number of town attractions N must be between 3 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 1000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: All road prices in the adjacency matrix must be between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == matrix[j][i] for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must be symmetric, meaning the price from i to j is the same as from j to i.
The diagonal elements of the adjacency matrix must be zero, indicating no cost for traveling to the same attraction.

postconditions.expression: len(set(matrix[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) if i != j)) == N * (N - 1) // 2
postconditions.description: All road prices must be distinct and positive, ensuring no two roads have the same price.
